params.prompt: Character model sheet of the companion cat shown in the first reference image, keeping exactly the same design and the same art style: a small gray-taupe cat with a cream face mask, cream chest and paws, pink inner ears, dark tail tip, big curious eyes, blue collar with a glowing cyan round tag, chibi proportions with a large head. Top row: four turnaround views standing on four legs on the same baseline, evenly spaced: front, three-quarter front, side profile, back. Bottom row: four poses: sitting and looking up, walking, alert with the tail raised and one paw pointing forward, curled up asleep. Plain light warm-gray background, even neutral lighting, identical proportions and colors in every view. Stylized low-poly 3D, faceted flat-shaded planes with hand-painted gradients, cel-shaded with rim light, matte materials. No text, no logos.
